pr_title: GameEngine: complete Timeline Audio Track adapter
pr_body:
## Summary

- add cursor-aware managed one-shot startup in the ADR 0122 audio runtime owner
- compose Timeline Audio Play/Stop/seek/fade lifecycle through managed voices and existing ADR 0122 spatial mixing
- mark Audio tracks seekable and cover seek reconstruction plus fade/stop semantics with regression tests

Visual validation is not required because this change is runtime/audio logic only.
